findings.title: Distributed stack math is sound
findings.detail: maxRunners=4 with 2×120Gi volumes and DoNotSchedule maxSkew=1 implies ≤2×44Gi+reserve per node; capacity contract tests cover full-stack, multi-node, and distributed-stack paths.

findings.title: Live apply is residual
findings.detail: Git does not mutate the QEMU cell. Live volumes may still be 48Gi; applying maxRunners=4 before 120Gi grow would overcommit disk (local-path does not enforce size). Helm must stay at maxRunners≤2 until volumes read back 120Gi, or use one-per-node packing only.

findings.title: CPU/RAM profile is document-only until recreate
findings.detail: CAPACITY-PROFILE-CI-HEAVY correctly states QEMU cannot hot-resize vCPU/RAM. Target 8/48 workers is host-aware (128Gi/18CPU). No agent auto-destroy of oya-talos.
